item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:55 HKT 02/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Chaba will move in the general direction of the coast of western Guangdong today. Its associated outer rainbands will also bring squally showers and thunderstorms to the region. Under the influence of an active southerly airstream, the weather is expected to remain unsettled over the coast of Guangdong next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Aere over the western North Pacific will move north in the general direction of the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands today and tomorrow.

Date/Month: 02/07 (Saturday)
Wind: East to southeast force 7 to 8, up to force 10 offshore and on high ground. Force 5 to 6 later.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times. Seas will be very rough with swells.
Temp range: 25 - 28 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
